title: MDIO PHY management target (IEEE 802.3 Clause 22) at PHY address 0x0C: 32 registers written and read over MDC / MDIO, register 0 preset to 0x1140

irqs.name: FRAME
irqs.desc: a management frame (to any PHY address) has been fully received

notes: mdio (open drain: the target pulls it low for the turnaround and read data) and mdc are the management pins; they pass through unchanged. The PHY registers are reached only over MDIO; the APB registers report frame completion. MDC is sampled on PCLK, so each MDC phase must last at least three PCLK clocks.
A frame starts at ST (0 then 1) after at least one idle 1 (preamble suppression is accepted). Writes to another PHY address are ignored and reads of another address are not answered.
